description.p: Canto is a Spotify client for the Linux desktop that puts your library, synced lyrics and listening flow front and center, without visual clutter.

p.em: Note: Canto requires a Spotify Premium account.

ul.li: Synced lyrics in the side panel or full screen, with the active line lighting up word by word
Colors that follow your desktop theme (including Omarchy themes, live) or the album cover
Now Playing panel with a big cover, lyrics preview, the next track and song credits
Your Library as a list or a grid of covers, with pinned items and a collapsed covers-only sidebar
Reopens on the track you closed it on, right where it stopped
Play here or on any Spotify Connect device, such as phones and smart speakers
Command palette (Ctrl+K) for navigation, themes, devices, sleep timer and search
Track radio, sleep timer, and scrobbling to Last.fm and ListenBrainz
Gapless playback with a 10-band equalizer, stereo pan and pitch shift
Media keys (MPRIS), keyboard shortcuts and touch gestures

description.p: Canto is a fork of Riff by Diego Augusto and contributors, itself descended from Spot by Alexandre Trendel.
